attackers_goals: Gain persistence by configuring a new screensaver.
description: An executable file with a screensaver extension was executed from the Users or temp folder. This is not a common behavior for screensavers and may indicate a malicious file disguised as a screensaver in the Users or temp folder. It is recommended to further investigate the execution flow for malicious indicators.
investigative_actions: Check whether the executing process (with the SCR extension) is benign and if this was a desired behavior as part of its normal execution flow.
name: Screensaver process executed from Users or temporary folder
